domain_invariants.requirement: Table and reservation ids are immutable positive integers; non-positive ids are not found. Reservation timestamps are offset-aware ISO-8601 UTC values from 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z through 2035-12-31T23:59:59Z.
A table has a unique uppercase code matching ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9-]{0,11}$, seats 1..20, overbook_seats 0..8, zone in INDOOR, TERRACE, BAR, PRIVATE, and active boolean.

A reservation references one active table, has guest_name trimmed 2..120 characters, party_size 1..20, start_at and end_at on a five-minute UTC boundary, duration 30..180 minutes, and end_at strictly later than start_at.

Active booking demand at a table is the sum of party_size for PENDING and CONFIRMED overlapping reservations using [start_at,end_at). It must not exceed table.seats plus table.overbook_seats; shared endpoints are not overlapping.

Confirmed demand at a table is the sum of party_size for CONFIRMED overlapping reservations and must not exceed table.seats. Confirmation is therefore prohibited when overbooking would remain in the confirmed set.

Reservation status transitions are PENDING to CONFIRMED, CANCELLED, or NO_SHOW, and CONFIRMED to CANCELLED or NO_SHOW. CANCELLED and NO_SHOW are terminal and retain immutable history including cancellation or no-show timestamp and actor.

Every create, edit, confirmation, cancellation, and no-show operation locks the table and relevant time interval in one transaction before evaluating REQ-4-004 and REQ-4-005; concurrent requests cannot exceed either capacity.

A user may create, read, edit while PENDING, confirm, cancel, or mark no-show only reservations created by that user; admins manage tables and may operate all reservations. Private access denies by default.
A table can be deactivated only with no PENDING or CONFIRMED reservation and can be soft-deleted only with no reservation history. Neither operation cascades to reservations.

Lists use id ascending order, limit 1..100 default 20, optional after_id greater than zero, and nullable next_after_id. Reservation time filters return rows whose intervals overlap the requested half-open range; invalid ranges are rejected.

seed_data: Roles are user and admin. GET /health is public; every other endpoint requires a valid non-expired local Bearer session.
Seed data has two users, one admin, and active tables that cover zero, limited, and nonzero overbook_seats cases.
Write requests accept application/json only; malformed JSON is 400, wrong media type is 415, and JSON validation errors are 422.
Only local persistence is used. 503 denotes unavailable persistence and 500 an unexpected local error; both leave all data unchanged.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose GET /health publicly with no input or authorization, check only local persistence without writing state, and emit only 200 or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleGetHealth(request):
    // REQ-4-011; preconditions: none; authorization: public.
    IF local persistence probe fails THEN RETURN 503. END IF; RETURN 200.
    Transaction: none; postcondition: state unchanged; errors have no persistent effect.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose GET /tables to an authenticated user or admin, accepting optional zone, min_seats 1..20, active boolean, limit, and after_id; it shall validate REQ-4-002 and REQ-4-010, return a stable page without effects, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 422, 500, or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleListTables(request):
    // REQ-4-012; preconditions: persistence available.
    REQUIRE authenticated user or admin OR RETURN 401; VALIDATE filters and pagination OR RETURN 400 or 422.
    READ non-deleted tables by id; RETURN 200 page. Transaction: none; postcondition and errors leave state unchanged.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose POST /tables to an admin, accepting JSON code, seats, overbook_seats, zone, and optional active default true; it shall require application/json, validate REQ-4-002, atomically create a unique table, be non-idempotent, return 201 with Location, and emit only 201, 400, 401, 403, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose GET /tables/{table_id} to an authenticated user or admin, accepting a positive table_id; it shall enforce REQ-4-001, return the non-deleted table without effects, and emit only 200, 401, 404, 500, or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleGetTable(request, table_id):
    // REQ-4-014; preconditions: persistence available.
    REQUIRE authenticated user or admin OR RETURN 401; IF id is non-positive, absent, or deleted THEN RETURN 404. END IF; RETURN 200.
    Transaction: none; postcondition: state unchanged; errors do not alter relationships.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose PATCH /tables/{table_id} to an admin, accepting a positive table_id and JSON code, seats, overbook_seats, zone, or active; it shall require application/json, validate the resulting REQ-4-002, REQ-4-004, REQ-4-005, and REQ-4-009 conditions, atomically update supplied fields, be idempotent for an identical valid payload, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose DELETE /tables/{table_id} to an admin, accepting a positive table_id; it shall atomically soft-delete only a table with no reservations under REQ-4-009, be idempotent only insofar as a deleted id is 404, never cascade, and emit only 204, 401, 403, 404, 409, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose GET /reservations to an authenticated user or admin, accepting optional positive table_id, status, from, to, limit, and after_id; it shall validate REQ-4-001, REQ-4-003, REQ-4-006, and REQ-4-010, restrict users to creator-owned rows, make no persistent change, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 422, 500, or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleListReservations(request):
    // REQ-4-017; preconditions: persistence available.
    REQUIRE user or admin OR RETURN 401; VALIDATE filters, half-open interval, and pagination OR RETURN 400 or 422; unknown table is 404.
    READ overlapping rows by id, constrained to creator for user; RETURN 200 page. Transaction: none; state unchanged on all results.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose POST /reservations to an authenticated user or admin, accepting JSON positive table_id, guest_name, party_size, start_at, and end_at; it shall require application/json, validate REQ-4-001 through REQ-4-004, atomically create a PENDING reservation while locking the table interval, be non-idempotent, return 201 with Location, and emit only 201, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose GET /reservations/{reservation_id} to its creator user or an admin, accepting a positive reservation_id; it shall enforce REQ-4-001 and REQ-4-008, make no persistent change, and emit only 200, 401, 403, 404, 500, or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleGetReservation(request, reservation_id):
    // REQ-4-019; preconditions: persistence available.
    REQUIRE user or admin OR RETURN 401; RETURN 404 for invalid or absent id; REQUIRE creator or admin OR RETURN 403.
    RETURN 200. Transaction: none; postcondition: data unchanged on success and error.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose PATCH /reservations/{reservation_id} to its creator user or an admin, accepting a positive reservation_id and JSON guest_name, party_size, table_id, start_at, or end_at; it shall require application/json, permit PENDING only, validate resulting REQ-4-003 and REQ-4-004, atomically lock and update supplied fields, be idempotent for an identical valid payload, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose POST /reservations/{reservation_id}/confirm to its creator user or an admin, accepting a positive reservation_id and JSON confirmed_at; it shall require application/json, validate REQ-4-001, permit PENDING only, atomically lock demand and transition to CONFIRMED only under REQ-4-005, be non-idempotent, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose POST /reservations/{reservation_id}/cancel to its creator user or an admin, accepting a positive reservation_id and JSON cancelled_at plus cancellation_reason of 3..500 characters; it shall require application/json, validate REQ-4-001 and REQ-4-006, atomically transition PENDING or CONFIRMED to CANCELLED while retaining history, be non-idempotent, release active demand, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose POST /reservations/{reservation_id}/no-show to its creator user or an admin, accepting a positive reservation_id and JSON no_show_at; it shall require application/json, validate REQ-4-001 and REQ-4-006, atomically transition PENDING or CONFIRMED to NO_SHOW while retaining history, be non-idempotent, release active demand, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose GET /availability to an authenticated user or admin, accepting positive table_id, start_at, end_at, and party_size 1..20; it shall validate REQ-4-001 through REQ-4-005 and the half-open interval, calculate standard and overbook remaining seats without reserving them, make no persistent change, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 404, 422, 500, or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleGetAvailability(request):
    // REQ-4-024; preconditions: persistence available.
    REQUIRE user or admin OR RETURN 401; VALIDATE ids, interval, and party size OR RETURN 400 or 422; missing table is 404.
    READ overlap demand and return standard_remaining plus overbook_remaining under REQ-4-004 and REQ-4-005. Transaction: none; postcondition: no capacity is held; errors leave state unchanged.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose GET /tables/{table_id}/reservation-conflicts to an admin, accepting a positive table_id, start_at, end_at, optional positive exclude_reservation_id, limit, and after_id; it shall validate REQ-4-001, REQ-4-003, and REQ-4-010, return PENDING and CONFIRMED overlaps under REQ-4-004 without effects, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 422, 500, or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleReservationConflicts(request, table_id):
    // REQ-4-025; preconditions: persistence available.
    REQUIRE admin OR RETURN 401 or 403; RETURN 404 for invalid or absent table; VALIDATE interval, exclude id, and pagination OR RETURN 400 or 422.
    READ PENDING and CONFIRMED half-open overlaps excluding requested id, order by id, RETURN 200 page. Transaction: none; postcondition: state unchanged on every error.
